question: centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
centre with the largest drop in attendance percentage between 2023 and 2024 (average of monthly rates, drop in percentage points, positive)
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_combined AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre_name,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance,
    2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "centre_name",
    "month",
    "enrolment",
    "average_attendance",
    2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
yearly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    year,
    AVG(CAST(average_attendance AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) AS avg_monthly_rate
  FROM attendance_combined
  GROUP BY centre_name, year
),
differences AS (
  SELECT
    r24.centre_name,
    (r23.avg_monthly_rate - r24.avg_monthly_rate) * 100 AS percentage_point_drop
  FROM yearly_rates r23
  JOIN yearly_rates r24 ON r23.centre_name = r24.centre_name
  WHERE r23.year = 2023 AND r24.year = 2024
)
SELECT
  centre_name
FROM differences
WHERE percentage_point_drop > 0
ORDER BY percentage_point_drop DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
